open_points.subject: discard_new_store
open_points.text: discard_new_store: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST act only on a store open_store made new in this process, answering removed false and touching nothing otherwise; it MUST close the store's connection, then remove in this order the store's write-ahead log, shared-memory and rollback-journal companion files and last the store's file, reading each path's type without following a link, removing only a regular file, passing over a path that does not exist, and stopping at the first step that fails.
open_points.rule:
Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов. Значение размещается процедурой 15.2 и доходит до кода одним из трёх путей §15.3.1; note называет
  перечисление адресом `= models.SomeStatus` (член — его именем рядом с адресом, §15.3.1),
  константу — именем импортируемого символа
  (`the imported RETRY_LIMIT constant`), настройку — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The companion-file paths or suffixes and their removal order must be placed in imported provider constants or a policy table, and the note must name those imported symbols instead of supplying the path policy in prose.
